tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Query complete IP intelligence: geolocation, ISP, ASN, IP type (residential/datacenter/mobile/VPN/proxy/Tor), risk score, and IPIPAI composite score (0-100 with grade A+ to D). This is the primary tool for IP analysis.

tools.name: check_ip_reputation
tools.description: Check IP reputation: proxy/VPN detection, Tor exit node, blacklist status, hosting/datacenter classification. Returns a verdict (Safe / Low / Medium / High / Critical Risk) with pass/fail checks.

tools.name: check_service_access
tools.description: Check if a specific service (ChatGPT, Claude, Netflix, Disney+, etc.) is accessible from a given IP location. Useful for diagnosing "why can't I access X?" questions.

tools.name: rate_ip_node
tools.description: Comprehensive rating for VPS, proxy nodes, and datacenter IPs. Returns overall score (0-100), grade (A+ to D), 5-star ratings for AI/streaming/stability/security/network, recommended use cases, and warnings.

tools.name: score_ip_node
tools.description: Score the quality and reliability of an IP/node using IP intelligence and network signals. Returns overall score (0-100), grade (A+ to D), 5-star ratings for AI/streaming/stability/security/network, recommended use cases, and warnings. Use this tool when the user asks whether an IP/node is high qual

tools.name: lookup_ip_location
tools.description: Quick IP geolocation lookup via OpenIPAPI. Returns country and city for an IP address. Lightweight and fast — no API key required.

tools.name: resolve_dns
tools.description: Resolve a domain name to its A (IPv4) and AAAA (IPv6) DNS records.

tools.name: ping_host
tools.description: Send ICMP ping packets to a host and measure latency. Returns min/avg/max latency and packet loss percentage.

tools.name: trace_route
tools.description: Trace the network path from the server to a target host. Returns hop-by-hop IP, hostname, and latency for each hop.

tools.name: lookup_domain_whois
tools.description: Query WHOIS registration info for a domain name or IP address. Returns registrar, creation date, expiry date, nameservers, and registrant info (if public).

tools.name: lookup_mac_vendor
tools.description: Identify the manufacturer of a network device by its MAC address using the OUI database.

tools.name: check_website_availability
tools.description: Check if major websites (Google, GitHub, YouTube, Wikipedia, etc.) are accessible from the server location. Useful for censorship and network restriction detection.
